items.weakness_text: Restrictive linear reward with known feature assumption for an adversarial hybrid setting
The core minimax optimization required at each round is computationally intractable in practice
Requirement for a pre-defined, finite partition of the model space into infosets where all models within an infoset share a unique optimal policy and value function
Assumption 4 (linear rewards with known features) for the hybrid setting is a strong structural limitation, assuming the learner has perfect knowledge of the reward representation
The paper is very difficult to read; many notions are supposed known and there is no attempt to aim at a bit of self contained presentation
Add discussion and intuition after each result or assumption (for example, Assumption 1)
Explain why the regret bound of off-policy exploration might be inferior to that of on-policy exploration as observed in Table 1
Explain how to construct the loss estimator without explicit learning of transitions, unlike prior occupancy measure or policy optimization methods
